description:
How do breakthrough hits actually happen? In this deep-dive analysis of Allen Gannett's "The Creative Curve: How to Develop the Right Idea at the Right Time", we shatter the cultural myth of the lone, divinely inspired genius.

From Mozart's rigorous early training and Benjamin Franklin's systematic imitation drills, to Netflix recommendation engines and the biological tug-of-war between neophilia and neophobia, discover why commercial success is engineered at the exact bell curve sweet spot: 90% familiar structure combined with a 10% novel twist.
